name: poker-lab
description: Offline NLHE cash-game research laboratory for studying decision-making in NL25 6-max simulations.

scripts.dev: concurrently -n server,web -c cyan,magenta "npm run dev -w @poker-lab/server" "npm run dev -w @poker-lab/web"
scripts.build: npm run build -w @poker-lab/core && npm run build -w @poker-lab/server && npm run build -w @poker-lab/web
